title: fix(components)!: the filter builder's row takes the spec rule's value, so an authored group reaches it without a cast
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9PNEMvJYp8jBTbfJYQEk5NM)_

Fixes #26306

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

**BREAKING** type-surface change, compile-time only. `FilterBuilderRow` is exported from `@object-ui/components` (`export * from './custom'`). What the builder accepts widens; what a reader of `row.value` (a host's `onChange` handler) may assume narrows, because the member is now optional and admits `null`. The changeset carries the reader's migration and the ADR-0087 disposition `not-required (runtime-interface-only ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx#FilterBuilderRow)`. It ships `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).

## What changed

The `filter-builder` renderer hands `schema.value` (the authored `FilterGroup` from `@object-ui/types`) to `FilterBuilder`, which is typed on its own `FilterBuilderRowGroup`. The builder's row now takes the spec rule's value by reference, so the authored group is assignable to the builder's group and the renderer needs no cast.

- **`FilterBuilderRow.value`** (`ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx`): `ViewFilterRule['value']` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`, plus the builder's own list member `(string | number | boolean)[]`, and optional. It was `string | number | boolean | (string | number | boolean)[]`, required.
- **`retypeFilterValue`**: a scalar with no value (`undefined`, `null`, `""`) is returned as it is instead of being converted. `isValueUnset` became a type predicate, which also removes the cast inside `normalizeToArray`.
- **The renderer** (`src/renderers/complex/filter-builder.tsx`): declares `value?: FilterGroup` on its props, because a host that binds the node forwards the group it holds. Both casts go: `value` was never cast on `main` (the `any` index signature carried it), and `fields={(schema.fields || []) as any}` becomes `fields={schema.fields || []}` (`FilterField[]` was already assignable).
- `docs/FilterBuilder.md` shows the new member. Changeset: `.changeset/26306-filter-builder-spec-row-value.md` (`patch`, BREAKING banner, migration for readers of `row.value`).

## Measurement: the spec's rule against both shapes

Spec: `ViewFilterRuleSchema` in `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`, read at `61ba04f68`. Types: `FilterBuilderCondition` / `FilterGroup` in `ui/packages/types/src/complex.ts`. Builder: `FilterBuilderRow` / `FilterBuilderRowGroup`.

| case | spec `ViewFilterRule` | types `FilterBuilderCondition` | builder `FilterBuilderRow` on `main` | here |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| value omitted (value-less operator) | `value?` | `value?: any` | required | optional, pinned |
| value `null` | admitted | admitted (`any`) | refused | admitted, pinned |
| boolean entry in a list or pair | refused | admitted (`any`) | admitted | **unchanged** (see Acceptance notes) |
| operator | `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS` | `ViewFilterOperator` by reference | those + opt-in `exists` / `notExists` | unchanged: every spec id is a builder id; the opt-in pair is the emit-side extension objectui#9559 ruling B keeps |
| row `id` | none (a console decoration the write path strips) | required (objectui#8415) | taken from types | unchanged: types and builder agree |
| group | none in the spec (a rule array) | `{ id?, logic, conditions }` | `conditions` restated only | unchanged |

The spec row itself needs no change, so nothing here goes to `domain:spec`.

The two value cases were not only type gaps. A field switch ran the absent value through `convertScalarToFamily`: a value-less row switched to a number column threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')` (`null` likewise), and on a text column it came back as the string `"undefined"`.

## Tests

New file `src/__tests__/filter-builder-spec-row-26306.test.tsx`, one pin per case this PR changes, driven through the real field dropdown with an authored group typed `FilterGroup` (no cast):

- value omitted: `{ field: 'title', operator: 'is_null' }` switched to a number column keeps no value.
- value `null`: `{ field: 'amount', operator: 'equals', value: null }` draws a blank input and keeps `null` through a switch to a currency column.
- Type pins (`tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): `FilterBuilderRow['value']` equals the spec's value plus the list member; `FilterGroup` and `FilterField[]` are assignable to the builder's props.

`filter-builder-name-authority-9306.test.tsx`: the value-extension pin now states the new member; the `@ts-expect-error` on a value-less row became a live fixture, and a new `@ts-expect-error` holds that an object value is still refused (the member is not `any`).

## Measured (head `6a63ec93`, `origin/main` `da99a4bd` merged in; the source under test is unchanged since `becb866e`)

- **Renderer with #26293's signature, no cast.** #26293's `renderer-host-props.ts`, its `base.ts` line (`[key: string]: unknown`) and its renderer annotation (`[key: string]: unknown } & RendererHostProps`) applied locally on top of this branch, with no `as` in the renderer: `tsc --noEmit` in `@object-ui/components` exits 0. Control leg, same mutation over `main`'s builder: exit 2, `filter-builder.tsx(49,11): error TS2322: Type 'FilterGroup | undefined' is not assignable to type 'FilterBuilderRowGroup | undefined'`. Neither change is pushed.
- **Reverse verification.** The new suite against `main`'s `custom/filter-builder.tsx` (byte-identical, hash checked; restored and checked against the HEAD blob): 2 of 2 red, `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'trim')` and `… of null (reading 'trim')`.
- **Tests.** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over every `packages/components/src/__tests__/filter-builder-*` file, `inline-locale-label-read-sites`, `share-filter-sort-spec-parity`, `record-picker-malformed-filter-10789`, plugin-list's two `convertFilterGroupToAST` suites and app-shell's `userFilterUrlState.listState-11860`: Test Files 26 passed (26), Tests 505 passed (505). Narrowed to the row's readers; the full package suites are CI's `Test UI` legs.
- **Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components --filter @object-ui/plugin-list --filter @object-ui/plugin-view --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both programs each, after building their dependency closure): exit 0. These are the packages that import `FilterBuilderRow` / `FilterBuilderRowGroup`.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 45 commands at `6a63ec93`; all 45 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 45 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Among them `check-sdui-manifest.mjs`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` and `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`, whose verdict line reads: `✓ check-adr-0087-registration: 1 declared-breaking changeset(s), each carrying an ADR-0087 disposition.` (`[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]  not-required (runtime-interface-only) -- verified: ui/packages/components/src/custom/filter-builder.tsx#FilterBuilderRow (interface)`).
- **ADR-0087 dispositions measured** (each committed on a throwaway commit at `3abe2733`, gate run, commit dropped): `runtime-interface-only` with the prose migration: exit 0. `runtime-interface-only` with a FROM / TO code block: exit 1, refused as a migration prescription (D7 inherits that refusal). `type-surface-only`, with either migration: exit 1, predicate 4 (`FilterBuilderRow` was already concrete at the merge base). So the migration for readers is prose, not a FROM / TO block.
- **Dogfood** (owed for the `(narrowing)` arm), `6a63ec93`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` under the lock after building its closure: Test Files 297 passed, 3 skipped (300); Tests 2528 passed, 18 skipped (2546); `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **Console.** `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console --concurrency=2` at `becb866e`: 71 tasks successful, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- **sdui.** `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` re-recorded `scripts/sdui-manifest.sources/components.json` only; `sdui.manifest.json` unchanged. #26293 (held) and #26274 also move that record, so whichever lands later merges `main` and re-records.

## Acceptance notes

- **The boolean list member is kept.** The spec's list holds strings and numbers; the builder's admits booleans and can emit one: an authored `equals true` row on a select column, switched to `in`, comes back as `[true]`, which `ViewFilterRuleSchema` refuses. Narrowing the member to the spec's was built and measured on this branch first: it is a breaking change to a published type, and `@object-ui/plugin-list`'s `UserFilters` fails to compile against it (it hands `LookupValuePicker` a `(string | number | boolean)[]`). It needs a file outside this claim, and its writers (`UserFilters`) would need a FROM → TO rewrite, which no ADR-0087 category admits for a type that was already concrete at the base (`type-surface-only` fails predicate 4, `runtime-interface-only` refuses a prescription; both measured, see below). So it is reported for its own card rather than made here. The builder's doc comment and the new test name the width as it is.
- `FilterBuilderSchema.onChange` is declared `(filter: FilterGroup) => void`, but the renderer calls the host's `onChange` with `{ target: { name, value } }`. Unchanged here; noted.
- #26293 drops its `as any` on `value` once this lands; its renderer annotation then type-checks as measured above.
